scripts.typecheck: bun check && bun run --cwd tui typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck && bunx tsc -p daemon/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.daemon:build:linux-arm64: mkdir -p daemon/dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 daemon/src/cli.ts --outfile daemon/dist/cadmus-daemon-linux-arm64
scripts.daemon:build:linux-x64: mkdir -p daemon/dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 daemon/src/cli.ts --outfile daemon/dist/cadmus-daemon-linux-x64
scripts.daemon:build: bun run daemon:build:linux-arm64 && bun run daemon:build:linux-x64
scripts.check:all: bun run web:test && bun run web:build && bun run format:check && biome check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:daemon && bun run test:conformance && bun run test
